Saves a stopped hierarchy/train writer's checkout as a 'WIP saved by AQ' commit fast-forwarded onto its own task branch, confined to the project's integration repository, then records the resume point. A non-fast-forward branch, another owner or another repository is left integration_managed for owner recovery; the release still goes through arelease_integration_writer_for_retry. Creates no aq/preserved ref, lifecycle journal or delivery claim.

Reads the branch ownership row so only the stopped task's own worker/repair writer has its checkout saved; a verifier or any other owner keeps owner recovery. Read-only: no storage, fence change or publication authority.
